🏛️ DHAKACOLO (Dhaka Colo Pvt. Ltd.)
I work at DhakaColo, Bangladesh’s commercial colocation and data center operator, headquartered at Khawaja Tower, 95 Bir Uttam AK Khandakar Road (10th floor), Mohakhali, Dhaka 1212. It runs facilities in Dhaka and Chattogram, with a Jashore site listed too. Its DAC 2 data center holds about 100 racks, built and operated to the TIA-942 Rated-3 (Tier-III) design standard with Uptime Institute Tier-III guidelines and ITIL practice. It reports a design PUE below 1.08, and sits on prime fiber routes from international carriers and backbones.
